scope: A source-bound finite audit of one declared 54-card to 54-facelet address mapping, six Rubik quarter-turn generators, the ordered 9|11 side partition, the arithmetic 33=3x11 bridge, two selected binomial-cube base translations, one declared decimal prime-address parser, its frozen n=2..100 negative census, four equivalent twelve-zero pack values, one two-source H4/H5 display lens and one H8 record-deck mode lens reusing the existing A0 Deck, Club, Control Room and Aperture Stack sources.

method.cube_positions: Enumerate {-1,0,1}^3 and classify by number of nonzero coordinates.
method.facelets: Attach one outward normal for every nonzero coordinate of each non-core cubie.
method.deck: Use 52 standard card labels plus two joker labels; declare four aces and two jokers as the six center anchors.
method.mapping: Map the 48 non-anchor cards in declared order to 24 corner-facelet and 24 edge-facelet slots; map the six anchors to center facelets.
method.moves: Apply exact integer quarter-turn rotations to R,L,U,D,F,B layers and check bijection, fixed anchors and fourth-power Return.
method.partition: Swap the ordered 9|11 movable-cubie partition twice and compare its sizes to the standard 8-corner|12-edge type partition.
method.prime_address: Apply the declared decimal parses 21|97, 2|19|7 and 12|1|67; verify prime values, indices, 184-101=p23 and the return to index 19.
method.negative_census: For every n from 2 through 100, scan interior decimal digit 1 split positions whose following suffix is prime and has no leading zero; retain each n once.
method.twelve_zero_pack: Compare the ordered exponent records (3,4), (4,3), (2,6) and (6,2) at base 10.
method.two_hand_source_lens: Reuse the Orientation Controller Bench C5 route 0->2->4->1->3->0 as the left display channel and the declared P13|P17|P23|C21 candidate/control sequence as the right display channel. Verify periods 5 and 4, all twenty product states and the first positive joint Return at tick 20.
method.h8_record_deck_mode_lens: Verify the existing Deck source exposes turntable, gramophone and digital profiles; LP, single and shellac presets; Newton, Leibniz and Goethe lenses; and that Club reuses the source while Control Room remains separate. Represent the Owner-requested 3+2+1 stack as six typed display positions and retain the Aperture Stack as a non-identical six-plate source.

claim_boundary: This is an exact finite counting, permutation, base-conversion, integer-factorization and Return audit of declared mappings plus source-bound H4/H5 and H8 display lenses. The decimal splits, subtraction by 101 and selected 13/23 chain are post-hoc address operators and not basis-invariant prime mechanisms. Eight suffix-prime census hits reject uniqueness in the frozen window. The 1+3+3+1 component count is not tesseract geometry. The twenty-tick two-hand Return follows only from the declared finite periods 5 and 4; it does not validate H4 generally, derive H5, establish a Riemann-Ihara identity or turn the candidate carousel into a Prime-Folding mechanism. H8's 3+2+1 grouping is a typed view over existing controls; RPM labels are not measurements, Newton/Leibniz/Goethe are not identical to AM/VM/PM historically, and the six H8 positions do not map automatically to the separate Aperture Stack plates. I-O-I, A-O-A-prime, 1-0-1 and Alpha-Lambda-Omega remain distinct projections. Nothing here establishes a natural card-cube isomorphism, a canonical 9|11 Rubik decomposition, a 33_r move, linguistic identity, physical mechanism, GPS architecture, research activation, finding, paper claim or publication authorization.
